reader.requirement: At --std 85 a relative file whose entry has no ACCESS MODE clause has sequential access: format 1 READ returns records by ascending RRN, WRITE releases consecutive RRNs from 1, sequential REWRITE follows a READ, and random-only forms (READ with INVALID KEY, START with no key) are refused.
reader.edition-search: FileModel.AccessMode defaults to FileAccessMode.Sequential with no edition test; BindFileControl sets it only from a written clause (MapAccessMode); KeyedIoEmitter.EmitRegistration passes (int)file.AccessMode. grep CobolVersion/DialectLevel/DialectBehaviors/Constructs over FileControlBinder*.cs, FileModel.cs and KeyedIoEmitter.cs found no switch on the access default (DialectLevel is only forwarded to the runtime for other behaviours).
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf19_06 covers READ order and WRITE numbering with no ACCESS clause; not variable-length records, I-O REWRITE, or the refusal of random-only statements (probed here).

probes.printed: RN [001   ] LEN 03 / RN [00004 ] LEN 05 / RN [0010  ] LEN 04 / RN [999LLL] LEN 06 / RN END 10 / RN REWRITE 00
probes.expected: no ACCESS clause: sequential, ascending RRN 1, 4, 10, 999 (7 deleted), each record at its own length; REWRITE after a READ succeeds

probes.printed: READ ... INVALID KEY: COBOL1720; START with no KEY phrase and no RELATIVE KEY: COBOL0862; READ NEXT AT END compiles
probes.expected: sequential access admits only the format 1 READ; START needs a RELATIVE KEY (§1985:VIII.2.4.3 SR5)

citations.check: OK  §1985:VIII.2.4.4 GR1  (2.4.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR1

reader.notes: The default is a property initializer on FileModel and is the same at every edition. At 85 a file with no ACCESS clause cannot have a RELATIVE KEY (VisitRelativeKeyClause refuses it), so such a file has no key, as the witness notes.

refuter.evidence: A file with no ACCESS clause must take every sequential-access rule, beyond the READ forms the reader probed (--std 85): r41-001 OPEN EXTEND admitted and runs 00 (§1985:VIII.4.4.3 SR1 allows EXTEND only in sequential access), WRITE in I-O mode 48 with USE run (Table 2: sequential WRITE only in output/extend), DELETE after READ 00, DELETE with no READ before it 43, REWRITE after READ 00, records read 'bbbb','CCCC' then 10. r41d-001 DELETE ... INVALID KEY refused COBOL1720 (§1985:VIII.4.3.3 SR1); r41r-001 REWRITE ... INVALID KEY refused COBOL1720 (§1985:VIII.4.6.3 SR3); control r41e-001 OPEN EXTEND of an ACCESS RANDOM file refused COBOL2372, so the EXTEND admission above is the access default, not a missing check. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:VIII.2.4.4 GR1  (2.4.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR1'; 'OK  §1985:VIII.4.4.3 SR1'; 'OK  §1985:VIII.4.3.3 SR1'; 'OK  §1985:VIII.4.6.3 SR3'.
